'''Coorsha''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who lived during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Coorsha commanded a ragtag [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighters]], [[I-7 Howlrunner]]s and [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]], which he used to raid regions of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] near to the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]]. At some point, he captured an [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|''Ton-Falk''-class escort carrier]], which he re-named ''[[Coorsha's Cross]]''.
